name: Mandelbrot Deep Zoom
desc: A perpetual slow-rotating deep zoom into the Mandelbrot boundary that continuously magnifies toward a seeded interesting point, revealing ever-new self-similar filigree as a cycling spectral palette descends with it, rendered as electric spectra, molten ember, glacial ice, saturated psychedelia, or a mono copperplate engraving.

scale.doc: maximum zoom depth before it ascends

seed.doc: picks the target point + palette offset
